Collect arena rewards when attempts run out and skip later arena tasks in the same run. JP Total Assault copies an owned gold-tier ranking squad to preset 4, squad 1, fights automatically, and continues a failed attempt with automatically formed squads 2, 3 and 4 in order. Higher difficulties are attempted after confirmed wins. Only a squad-1 clear raises the season sweep level; multi-squad clears raise the current game-day sweep level. After four squads fail, stop ascending for this season and use the single-squad sweep level on subsequent days. Grand Assault searches owned gold-tier teams for up to five minutes per region and saves them to preset 4 squads 2–4. Each region starts at Extreme, continues with four squads, and keeps multi-squad clears as the season sweep level. After all four squads fail with no verified clear, step down until a clear is confirmed. Then sweep that difficulty for this season. If a clear already exists, sweep the highest verified difficulty. Runtime injection leaves upstream sources and configuration intact.
